description: The line graph illustrates the performance of different data sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—across varying numbers of tokens, with the x-axis representing the "Number of Tokens" on a linear scale ranging from 200 to 900 in increments of 200, and the y-axis showing a numerical value (likely performance or accuracy) ranging from 10 to 40. The blue line, representing Tutorials, starts at approximately 23 and shows a steady increase, peaking at around 29 at 800 tokens before slightly declining. The red line, for Library Documentation, begins at about 26 and rises to a peak of approximately 32 at 800 tokens, then decreases to around 27. The yellow line, corresponding to StackOverflow posts, starts at about 33 and exhibits a consistent downward trend, decreasing to roughly 12 at 900 tokens. The green line, representing Github files, begins at approximately 28, increases to a peak of about 33 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to around 30. All lines display a general trend of increasing performance up to 800 tokens, followed by a decline or stabilization, with the StackOverflow posts line showing the most significant drop.
